name: glue_collapse
title: Collapse a vector into one string

origin.description: Paste a character vector into one string, with a special separator before the last item.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: If the joined string is wider than this, keep width - 3 characters and add ...

arguments.name: last
arguments.text: Separator used before the final item when there are at least two.

origin.details: A missing value makes the result missing. An empty vector becomes an empty string. width uses nchar(type = "width") and then substr.

translation.description: Join values into one string. Numbers are converted the way R's as.character converts them.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: If the joined string is wider than this, keep width - 3 characters and add ...

arguments.name: last
arguments.text: Separator used before the final item when there are at least two.

translation.details: A missing value makes the result missing. An empty list becomes an empty string. For ASCII text, width is the number of characters.
translation.example:
from glue import glue_collapse
print(glue_collapse([1, 2, 3, 4], ", ", last=" and "))
